Class InventoryView

java.lang.Object
com.pos.InventoryView
public class InventoryView extends Object
Manager view where managers can view, add, and update inventory items, quantities, and minimum restock thresholds. Items are stored in the inventory table in PostgreSQL.
Author:
Alan, Rishab, Humaid Syed
